scripts.build: cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --release && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && node frontend/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check frontend/app frontend/shared frontend/server frontend/nuxt.config.ts scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.format: cargo fmt --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && node frontend/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write frontend/app frontend/shared frontend/server frontend/nuxt.config.ts scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.audit: npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=low && cargo audit --file backend/Cargo.lock
